emptyStates.vaultEmptyText: You don't have any items yet. Add your first password or import the ones you already keep in Bitwarden or your browser.
emptyStates.nothingSelectedText: Pick an item from the list to see its details. Use ↑ ↓ to move and Ctrl K to find anything.

details.deleteForeverText: “{{itemTitle}}” and its attachments will be permanently erased. This can't be undone.

editor.shortcutsHint: Ctrl S to save · Esc to cancel
editor.totpHint: Paste the secret key or the otpauth:// link the site shows when you enable two-step verification.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.none: No attachments. Files are stored encrypted next to the vault (max 50 MB).

generator.title: Password generator
generator.subtitle: Create random passwords or easy-to-remember passphrases.

health.title: Your password health
health.weakExplanation: These are easy to guess. Replace them with generated passwords.
health.reusedExplanation: If one site is breached, every account sharing the password is exposed.
health.oldExplanation: Not changed in over a year.
health.allGoodText: No weak, reused or old passwords found.
health.noLoginsText: Once you save logins, you'll see here which ones could be improved.

folders.name: Folder name
folders.deleteText: The folder “{{folderName}}” will be deleted. Its items are kept and moved to “No folder”.

palette.title: Command palette
palette.placeholder: Search an item or type an action…

setup.welcomeText: A private password manager that runs only on this computer.
setup.pointLocal: Your data never leaves your computer: no cloud, no accounts.
setup.pointEncryption: Everything is encrypted with XChaCha20-Poly1305 and an Argon2id-derived key.
setup.pointMasterPassword: A single master password protects all the others.
setup.noRecoveryTitle: Your master password can't be recovered
setup.noRecoveryText: No copy is stored anywhere. If you forget it, nobody (not even us) can open your vault.
setup.tipsTitle: Tips for a good master password
setup.tipPassphrase: Use 4 or more random words, e.g. “glacier-mantis-orbit-velvet”.
setup.tipWriteDown: Write it on paper and keep it somewhere safe until you've memorized it.
setup.understood: I understand it can't be recovered
setup.createText: At least 12 characters and a “Strong” rating or better.
setup.violationTooWeak: Still easy to guess: add more words or characters

unlock.title: Unlock vault
unlock.subtitle: Enter your master password to continue.
unlock.lockedByInactivity: Locked after inactivity to keep your data safe.
unlock.lockedByMinimize: Locked when the window was minimized.

settings.securityDescription: Control when the vault locks and how long copied data stays around.
settings.lockOnMinimizeHint: Useful if you share this computer or step away often.
settings.masterPasswordDescription: Changing it doesn't re-encrypt your items, only the key that protects them.
settings.backupAdvice: Make regular backups with “Export › Encrypted backup” and keep them off this computer.

transfer.importDescription: Bring in passwords from Bitwarden, your browser or another RustVault backup.

importHints.bitwardenJson: In Bitwarden: Tools › Export vault › .json format (not the encrypted one).
importHints.bitwardenCsv: In Bitwarden: Tools › Export vault › .csv format.
importHints.browserCsv: In your browser: Settings › Passwords › Export passwords.
importHints.encryptedVaultExport: You'll need the password the backup was created with.

transfer.exportDescription: Create a backup or move your data to another manager.
transfer.filePasswordHint: At least 12 characters. Can differ from your master password.
transfer.plaintextWarning: This format stores all your passwords UNENCRYPTED. Anyone with access to the file can read them. Delete it as soon as you're done.
transfer.chooseExportFile: Where should the export be saved?
